My approach

Listen first.
Explore together.

I’m Farra Affandi. You may know me as Akak Hydrogen.

My work brings together hydrogen wellness experiences, beauty learning and conversations about business opportunities. Whether you are curious about a session or exploring something new, I believe the starting point is understanding what you are looking for.

With 10 years in beauty and wellness therapy, I help you understand your options through personal explanations and guidance.

Ask about the equipment, the session, the coaching or the practical next step. There is room for your questions.
